sn22.66:1.2: Then a certain bhikkhu approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn22.66:1.3: “Venerable sir, it would be good if the Blessed One would teach me the Dhamma in brief….”
sn22.66:1.4: “Bhikkhu, you should abandon desire for whatever is impermanent.”
sn22.66:2.1: “In what way, bhikkhu, do you understand in detail the meaning of what was stated by me in brief?”
sn22.66:2.2: “Form, venerable sir, is impermanent; I should abandon desire for it.
sn22.66:2.6: Consciousness is impermanent; I should abandon desire for it.
sn22.66:2.7: “It is in such a way, venerable sir, that I understand in detail the meaning of what was stated by the Blessed One in brief.”
sn22.66:3.2: It is good that you understand in detail the meaning of what was stated by me in brief.
sn22.66:3.7: Consciousness is impermanent; you should abandon desire for it.
sn22.66:3.8: It is in such a way that the meaning of what was stated by me in brief should be understood in detail.”
sn22.66:3.9: … And that bhikkhu became one of the arahants.
